content: Official Expo documentation describes the platform as building universal native iOS, Android, and web apps; current Expo ImagePicker API exposes launchCameraAsync and launchImageLibraryAsync. Npm registry latest versions observed 2026-10-20: expo 58.0.16, react-native 0.88.0, expo-image-picker 58.0.10, expo-router 58.0.24; install Expo SDK-matched dependencies with expo install.
